headline: Last session: Indian indices traded with volatility as crude oil prices climbed above $116 amid mixed global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: GST collections surged 23% to ₹2.31 lakh crore in October, driven by festive demand
Crude oil prices remained elevated above $116 per barrel, impacting market sentiment
FPIs turned net buyers at the end of October despite a total monthly outflow of ₹34,843 crore
Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches crossed the five-lakh units mark in October
whatHappening: Eicher Motors reported a 7% rise in October sales with a significant 47% jump in exports
Syngene expects a stronger second half of the year supported by its order book and Zoetis supplies
EPFO has introduced WhatsApp services and automated settlement for PF accounts up to ₹1,000
Markets are preparing for the upcoming week with a focus on Diwali and geopolitical risks
summary: The Indian stock market is currently closed for the weekend following a volatile final session where crude prices rose above $116. Positive economic data, including record GST collections and strong festive auto sales, provided a supportive backdrop. Investors are now looking ahead to the Diwali week for a potential market rebound.
